title: Mandating Online Platforms in Singapore to Incorporate Safety-by-design Principles to Prevent Child Sexual Exploitation
what_it_is: Mandating Online Platforms in Singapore to Incorporate Safety-by-design Principles to Prevent Child Sexual Exploitation

sections.label: IMDA action against X
sections.summary: IMDA found serious weaknesses in X's detection of child sexual exploitation material, issued a Letter of Caution and placed X under Enhanced Supervision.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: Additionally, these services are required to put in place systems and processes to mitigate Singapore users' exposure to harmful content, including child sexual exploitation material.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: These are aligned with safety-by-design principles that require platforms to build proactive safeguards and prevent harm, rather than react to the harm that occurs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: In the latest Online Safety Assessment Report for designated social media services published on 31 March 2026, IMDA found serious weaknesses in X's measures to proactively detect and remove child sexual exploitation and abuse material on its platform.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: IMDA issued a Letter of Caution to X and placed it under Enhanced Supervision to hold it accountable to rectify its serious weaknesses.

sections.label: Reviewing online safety regulatory ambit
sections.summary: Singapore is reviewing whether to extend its regulatory ambit to other online services such as AI chat bots, messaging and gaming services.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: It is part of our efforts to enhance online safety in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: This also includes whether to extend our regulatory ambit to include other types of online services, such as what the Member mentioned – the AI chat bots, messaging, gaming services and we are reviewing this.

sections.label: IMDA and Social Media Services Code
sections.summary: IMDA works with designated social media services under the SMS Code, which requires online safety measures including safeguards addressing child sexual exploitation.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: For this purpose, it is IMDA, which works with the designated social media services under the Code of Practice for Online Safety – Social Media Services, what we call the Social Media Services (SMS) Code.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: The SMS code imposes requirements on the designated social media services to put in place online safety measures, including safeguards to address child sexual exploitation.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: The Commissioner of Online Safety is empowered to issue directions to platforms, but these are in response to individual cases, because it has to be triggered by the victims.
